scope.summary: Guard read-purity regression fixed: the ALL_POLICIES/ALL_TAB_COLS visibility proof now gates on Ok-vs-error rather than row count, so a successful empty catalog probe proves no VPD (no longer refuses all reads on VPD-less DBs like gvenzl free23) while a genuine catalog-blind error still fails closed; C8 pair updated to enshrine the corrected semantics.
out_of_scope: OLS / Real Application Security / Data Redaction row-filtering (tracked as pre-existing boundary bead nn3ne, kept open)
the CQN and OneRowMock test mocks (beads 1dtoq / 7iyp6)

entry_points.name: resolved_relations_read_purity empty-success proof + C8 unit pair
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-db/src/catalog_resolver.rs: prove_policy_catalog_readable now treats a successful (even zero-row) ALL_POLICIES probe as positive proof of no VPD and an error as fail-closed blindness (see the Ok-vs-error comment ~line 504). The C8 pair (c8_a_catalog_blind_principal_must_not_yield_a_read_only_proof + the empty-success ProvenReadOnly case) enshrines it; cargo test -p oraclemcp-db. Fix landed in ancestor f7b1edc7 'fix(guard): recognize a successful empty catalog probe as proof of no VPD'; d1732c5e only reformatted the function signature.

limitations: This is a deliberate, analyzed LOOSENING of the read-purity proof that does not re-open the fa93e169 fail-open (an unreadable catalog still errors and refuses). Object-scoped VPD, virtual columns, views, db-links and unresolved objects still fail closed. source.sha is the last commit touching catalog_resolver.rs (d1732c5e); the guard fix landed in ancestor f7b1edc7. Full-suite + live free23 ladder green is asserted by CI at HEAD f1d1d223, not re-run here.
follow_ups: oraclemcp-nn3ne (open, P3): OLS / RAS / Data Redaction row-filtering are outside the ALL_POLICIES VPD read-purity proof (pre-existing, orthogonal; future-hardening).
